name: print-social-cobalt-and-grey-concentric-arc-post-frames-with-title-variants
title: Cobalt and Grey Concentric Arc Post Frames
whatItIs: Four Instagram frames on light grey: a cobalt post with a white headline and concentric arcs, a grey post with fine arcs and a black headline, a split post with a phone-in-hand photo above a cobalt band and a grey post with a large cobalt half-disc holding a ring logo above a one-line title.
whatItMeans: One arc motif reused in cobalt and grey gives a set cohesion, and the ring logo repeats in each frame.
techniques: Concentric arcs as the shared background
Cobalt and pale grey as the two-colour base
Ring logo repeated as a mark
Monochrome photo for the split post
Light headline weights for a calm tone

vocabulary.definition: Concentric curved lines used as a signature pattern.
A semicircle used as a bold shape.
A system built from two main colours.
